_meta.metric: ecr = expert consensus rank ≈ ADP. overall_rank is the draft board order.
_meta.range_note: best/worst = most optimistic/pessimistic expert; sd = spread. Tight range -> take now or lose him. Wide range -> he may slip to your next pick.
_meta.avoid_flag: players carrying an 'avoid' field are on a do-not-draft/bust list (see espn_avoid_2026.json)
